rejection_summary.title: The Infinite Man
rejection_summary.reason: Inventive escalating time-loop mechanics, but the film is primarily a romantic comedy/personal relationship puzzle rather than sustained scientific investigation; baseline fit remains below the 82 threshold.

rejection_summary.title: Omni Loop
rejection_summary.reason: Two quantum physicists actively investigate time travel, but the film is deliberately repetitive, low-energy and ultimately more focused on mortality and family than sustained rule discovery or escalating scientific payoff; baseline fit remains below 82.

rejection_summary.title: Phase IV
rejection_summary.reason: Strong scientist-led ecological investigation of rapidly evolving intelligent ants, but sluggish execution, creature-conflict structure and an intentionally vague theatrical payoff keep the deterministic baseline fit below 82.
